C0032.title: Ningbo, Zhejiang: Illegal Flash Sale Software Used to Snatch Limited Goods for Profit
C0032.summary: In June 2024, Ningbo police cracked an illegal purchasing case, arresting Sheng and Zheng, seizing order-snatching software and source code, and recovering over 200 bottles of premium liquor on site. The suspects exploited algorithm cracking and AI programming to execute millisecond-level purchases, targeting limited items in e-commerce livestream rooms, with the total amount involved exceeding 10
